note: Species whose templates Nick has ratified (all 29 as of 2026-09-03, PR #73). Only these are bundled into lambda/src/json/speciesRecords.json by scripts/bundleLore.js; *-run.* files and unratified drafts never ship. A new species is added here only after ratification.

lore.description: A lean upright creature with enormous fringed ears, slit eyes that gather what little light the sky still gives, and a spread of long plumed tail fronds, the Akinza was generated on Krystos after the impact, when the blotted sky ended the dainty and graceful stock and the Generator turned to lifeforms capable of surviving in the harsh, frozen tundra. It belongs to the feral stock that remained in the arctic wastelands outside the high-security prison complexes, where such creatures proved as useful for deterring escape as the guards inside. The Akinza moves through open snow without sound or track and sneaks through the night with ease.
lore.biomeNiche: the arctic wastelands outside the prison complexes, worked at night

signatureAbility.name: Silence of the Long Night
signatureAbility.description: The Akinza crosses open snow without sound or track and is on its target before it has been seen.

lore.description: Carnivorous little green birds with bright, floral plumage, Avililies flit between Floria’s trees, camouflaging into the planet’s many flowery meadows as they travel. Their beaks resemble the closed petals of a flower but when they open their mouths that 'flower' blooms. They attract insects with their sweet, syrupy smelling saliva and vibrant floral display, but their saliva contains a powerful sedative which paralyzes anything that it comes in contact with. In ancient times, Avililies were used by Vallerii scientists and explorers to trap insects, serving as mobile bug repellent on Florian ventures. Today, the sedative properties of their saliva have been enhanced for a far-more dangerous galaxy, and swarms of flittering Avililies protect the most sacred parts of Floria’s jungles, paralyzing and consuming all who dare to threaten the pristineness of their forests.
lore.biomeNiche: flowering meadows and jungle canopy of the Florian underforests

signatureAbility.name: Blossoming Ambuscade
signatureAbility.description: The Avilily opens its beak into a false bloom and coats what comes to feed in a syrup that stops it where it stands.

lore.description: An acid slime organism protected by a thick rocky exoskeleton, the Bioflim was bioengineered by Drainov's Xalian Generator for a world of bubbling acid swamps and steaming corrosive rain. Its slime continually regenerates the outer shell, which is the whole of its defense. Drainov is now held by a loose conglomerate of Vallerii space pirates and interstellar crime syndicates, and its Xalians work the once-abandoned factories, refineries, and chemical plants. The Bioflim stands in the acid of that world and regenerates whatever the acid takes.
lore.biomeNiche: the acid swamps and reopened chemical plants of Drainov

signatureAbility.name: Everforming Carapace
signatureAbility.description: The slime beneath floods over the broken plates and hardens into new shell faster than the acid can take it away.

lore.description: Used in ancient times to quickly harvest the vast crop yields of Luminax's fields, the large, albino feline known as the Chromocat possesses two sickle-shaped blades infused with pure ionized radiation that extend backwards from its front paws. These 'energy swords' allowed them to cut through grains with minimal effort, and their ability to enter a photonic-state and leap through fields at the speed of light meant they could comb through and harvest entire fields in record time. Today, their wicked speed and ionic blades allow them to seemingly 'teleport' around the battlefield, harassing their opponents by barraging them with rapid cuts in a slice-and-dice pattern so swift that reaction becomes nearly impossible.
lore.biomeNiche: the cultivated fields of Luminax's sunward face

signatureAbility.name: Harvest at the Speed of Light
signatureAbility.description: The Chromocat crosses the ground to its target in its photonic state and opens it with a barrage of rapid cuts from its ionized sickles.

lore.description: A lean, upright digger whose raised tail carries a fan of banded explosive barbs, the Codazzo was generated on Stonera, a world that crosses the Jorian Belt each year under a planetwide bombardment of asteroids and meteors, where the Generator produced Xalians that could quickly dig their way to safety. When spooked it digs its body underground and exposes only that tail. If provoked it will not hesitate to fire off a few projectiles, and its regenerative power quickly grows more.
lore.biomeNiche: tunneler in the fissured rock and craters of Stonera

signatureAbility.name: Buried Quiver
signatureAbility.description: The Codazzo sinks its body into the ground until only the tail stands clear, then fires barbs at whatever comes near and grows them back.

lore.description: A heavy, long-haired Xalian that sits upright on folded legs, the Crystorn carries a pair of crystal horns on its head that transmit powerful light energy. It was generated on Luminax, where the Xalians grown for the world took on albino features or prismatic crystal to survive the brilliant light of its twin suns as they worked the fields and the oases of translucent, alabaster flora. Its temperament is calm, and the calm is deceiving. Where the misfiring panels of the Stellaris Superstructure have left sun-scorched blast zones on the surface, some of the Xalians of Luminax have survived in the residual radiation, and the Crystorn is among the world's survivors.
lore.biomeNiche: the sunward oases of translucent, crystalline-leaved flora on Luminax

signatureAbility.name: Coronet of the Twin Suns
signatureAbility.description: The Crystorn holds still until its crystal horns release the light they carry in one narrow line.

lore.description: A dog-sized, scorpion-like creature whose arched tail ends in a small stinger-like drill, the Drilltail was originally used by wildcatters on Endessa who lacked the funding to employ larger drilling Xalians like the Frackworm. It uses its drill to quickly tunnel through the earth, darting in and out of the surface as it hunts for prey to ambush with its sharp, scissor-like claws. Endessa's wildcatters drilled haphazard wells through large cavern networks beneath the dunes, and the Drilltail still tunnels there.
lore.biomeNiche: the packed sand and deep cavern networks of Endessa's Nightcap wells

signatureAbility.name: Wildcatter Auger
signatureAbility.description: The Drilltail runs a shaft beneath its quarry and comes up under it drill first.

lore.description: A partially feathered ground bird with lizard features, built long in the leg and narrow in the skull, the Dromeus was designed by Magmuth's corporations for the transient mineral islands, fast enough to cross a cooling lava flow before it opened underfoot. It is extremely quick and carries razor sharp teeth. At speed it spreads its wings and takes flight for a few seconds, launching into the air to sink its teeth into its prey. It still runs the ash fields of Magmuth, where the blood feuds of the company wars have never ended.
lore.biomeNiche: the ash fields and hardened lava flows of Magmuth's transient islands

signatureAbility.name: Ashfall Stoop
signatureAbility.description: The Dromeus runs its target down, spreads its wings for the few seconds it can stay aloft, and closes the last of the distance with its teeth.

lore.description: A spectral green mist that gathers into the vague impression of a grinning skull trailing a ghost-like tail for a body, the Ectoghoul was among the forms the Phantiri Generator produced once the Leviticus Overdrive taught it to make life the moon-weapon could not read as living, a body the killing signal ignores, drifting where organic laborers dropped dead on the spot. Nothing now issues it orders. It zips across the tarry oceans and splayed forests of the mass grave, passing through surfaces, disappearing and re-appearing at will, and amuses itself instead by terrorizing other Xalians, announcing every arrival with a cackle and answering any challenge with a blast of gooey ectoplasm.
lore.biomeNiche: drifting scavenger of the Dreadscape corpse islands and tarry oceans

signatureAbility.name: Rictus of the Dreadscape
signatureAbility.description: The mist tightens into a grinning skull and lets out a cackle that reaches its target wherever it goes.

lore.description: A small antlered creature with outsized ears, wide eyes and a shaggy coat, the Figzy carries in its raised hands more force than its stature admits. The Telypso Generator built it to counterbalance the unstable auras of the Vallerii marooned planetside, treating the prisoners as patients rather than removing them, and the Figzy was one of the small psychic bodies that emerged from the fungal forests to steady what the deranged left behind. It is deceptively smart and goes docile with anything it has come to trust. The Nemesis Plague now turns the creatures of Telypso against one another, and a Figzy that trusts no one raises its hands against its own kind.
lore.biomeNiche: the fungal forests and bioluminescent jungles of Telypso

signatureAbility.name: Small Hands of the Psychosphere
signatureAbility.description: The Figzy raises both hands and the force it has been holding back leaves them all at once.

lore.description: A tall upright creature whose hands are long drill-like horns and whose head carries two thin antennae, the Foromeer has a metallic exoskeleton on its limbs and is thought to once have been used for mineral excavation on Veridium, a world of dull, metallic crust with veins of heavy metals striking their way deep into it. Its powerful horns can break through the strongest of material. Since Source Code 606 released the Veridians from the oversight of their robotic masters, the demand for Veridium's factories has troughed, and the planet's Xalians tinker with salvaged drones, robots, and machines.
lore.biomeNiche: the ore-filled soil and heavy-metal veins of Veridium's mineral crust

signatureAbility.name: Vein Breaker
signatureAbility.description: The Foromeer sets its drill hands against whatever stands in front of it and bores through.

lore.description: With the black-shelled body of a crab and an upright torso, the centaur-like crustacean known as the Graviclaw lurks just beneath the foggy wetlands of Grimedes, using its bizarre control over the intensification of gravitational waves to generate miniature black holes in the water and draw its helpless prey right into its clutches. Graviclaws can strengthen the gravitational pull of their massive claws in order to snap them shut with a force many times heavier than their implied mass, severing through even the hardest of materials with crushing pressure. When facing larger foes, the Graviclaw can use its powers to root itself to the ground, becoming an immovable wall of chitin.
lore.biomeNiche: submerged ambusher in the foggy wetlands beneath Grimedes' thick, stalky undergrowth

signatureAbility.name: Point of No Return
signatureAbility.description: It opens a claw beneath the water and collapses the gravitational waves inside it until nothing within reach can swim away from the closing grip.

lore.description: A four-legged creature resembling a seahorse, crested and spined along its neck and back, with a long trunk-like snout and a tightly curled tail. Hippochamps were designed as emergency response crews for the electrical and chemical fires that occur on Poseidas's hydro-processing rigs, and as a means of defense against pirates seeking to steal valuable Algael. The snout serves as a high-pressure water cannon that maintains a steady stream, hosing down fires and threats alike. It patrols the hydro-processing fleets, rig upon rig in interlocking nets of floating industrial zones trawling a global ocean for algae.
lore.biomeNiche: the interlocking floating industrial zones of Poseidas's hydro-processing fleets

signatureAbility.name: Hydrostatic Lance
signatureAbility.description: The long snout holds one unbroken high-pressure stream on a fire or a threat for as long as the pressure lasts.

lore.description: Hypnopets resemble glowing, golden-furred bunny rabbits with a single color-changing unicorn horn atop their heads. They were created by the Telypso Generator as service animals and therapists for the insane Vallerii imprisoned on the world, where their natural empathic healing abilities served to balance and treat patients. When their horn begins to pulse and swirl with psychedelic color, it hypnotizes others and locks them in a trance, which was useful for sedating patients when they entered into dangerous bouts of mania. With the Nemesis Plague reducing the patient population of Telypso, many Hypnopets have taken to the stars as healers, though some have been forced into service by King Kozrak, who uses their hypnotic abilities as crowd control on rebellious worlds.
lore.biomeNiche: the bioluminescent fungal forests and mist-smothered jungles of Telypso, working among the world's marooned Vallerii patients

signatureAbility.name: Psychedelic Reverie
signatureAbility.description: Its horn pulses and swirls through shifting color until whatever watches it stops moving and stands quiet in the trance.

lore.description: Imprits are demonic looking creatures, resembling flaming, horned monkeys backed by long tails with scythe-like tips. Imprits possess fire-retardant fur that protects their bodies from the flammable oils they secrete, allowing them to survive despite being in a state of constant immolation.  They are remarkably intelligent among other Xalians, having been designed in ancient times as natural tinkerers and let loose into the various lightless mining shafts of Magmuth, where they were left to their own devices to fix and maintain the often makeshift mining equipment sent deep into the earth by the Vallerii. Today, they are known for being entirely erratic, likely driven mad by the isolation of the deep tunnels in which they tinkered and toiled. When released from their claustrophobic confines and set loose on the surface, Imprits take ecstatic pleasure from using their tails to swing through the air from place to place and setting fires where they least belong.
lore.biomeNiche: the lightless mining shafts sunk under Magmuth's obsidian islands

signatureAbility.name: Ecstasy of the Deep Shafts
signatureAbility.description: The Imprit wrings its flammable oils out across everything within reach and lets its own burning body set them alight.

lore.description: A heavy four-legged creature whose long ribbed trunk arches back over its shoulders and ends in a broad sweeping blade, the Kosanos is thought to have been designed to clear the thick brush of Floria, a world on which the Vallerii kept small settlements, research labs, and exploration parties and no more. It is a simple yet powerful creature. It works the underforests below the World Trees, felling standing growth in slow arcs of the blade.
lore.biomeNiche: the dense underforests and marshy wetlands beneath the World Tree canopies

signatureAbility.name: Understory Reaping
signatureAbility.description: The Kosanos swings its trunk in a long low arc and opens a lane through everything standing in it.

lore.description: A long-eared bounding animal of the floating islands of Saiphus, slight in the body and hugely muscled in the hind legs, with two curved horns swept back along its skull like a battering ram and a long plumed tail. The Saiphus Generator created the great leaping animals that bounded between islands as if gravity held no sway over them, on a world whose habitable surface is broken into buoyant chunks separated by a sea of clouds and dense fog. The Luceras can jump so high that at times it seems as if it is flying. Once up in the air, it comes missiling down on its enemy like a battering ram.
lore.biomeNiche: the gaps between the floating islands of Saiphus's upper-atmosphere life band

signatureAbility.name: The Long Fall of Saiphus
signatureAbility.description: The Luceras leaps until it seems to fly, then comes missiling down horns first on its enemy like a battering ram.

lore.description: Colossal hydrogen jellyfish that travel in free-floating herds across Saiphus's lower atmosphere, the Neph are instrumental to the Benthane industry. These domesticated creatures roam the clouds in flocks, grazing off of the biochemicals and atmospheric plankton contained in the gas-liquid slush of Saiphus's deeper atmosphere using long, trailing tentacles that vacuum up valuable Benthane along with their food. When threatened, these same tentacles can be used to pull in opponents with considerable suction or to jettison air at high pressure. Neph can also forcibly expel jets of Benthane gas, which is typically used a coolant for starship engines, from their tentacles in order to blast their enemies with freezing air. Finally, being composed almost entirely hydrogen means that the Neph can also spray their enemies with bouts of flammable gas.
lore.biomeNiche: the cloud layers of Saiphus's lower atmosphere, where Benthane plumes rise

signatureAbility.name: Benthane Coldwind
signatureAbility.description: The Neph forces the coolant gas banked in its tentacles out through their open ends, washing everything before it in a freezing white plume.

lore.description: A sixteen legged amphibious creature with a long, segmented body, the Newtapede was generated on Poseidas among the aquatic, water-breathing Xalians capable of surviving in its rising and acidifying oceans. While adapted to land, its slender frame and webbed feet make it a formidable opponent in water. The rigs of Poseidas were built deeper and deeper beneath the ocean to avoid the storms, and the Newtapede lives in the water around them.
lore.biomeNiche: a swimmer and rig hand of the deep-city waters, at home in an acidifying global ocean

signatureAbility.name: Sixteenfold Undertow
signatureAbility.description: The Newtapede wraps its whole segmented length around a swimmer and holds it under.

lore.description: A plated biped shielded by a scaly exoskeleton, banded from neck to tail, the Scalatto can roll into a ball to protect itself. It was generated on Endessa, where a prototype Xalian Generator stolen from an ECHELON fleet supplies the Xalians that drill Nightcap beneath the dunes, and it lives in the sand and the cavern networks of that world.
lore.biomeNiche: the dunes and cavern networks of Endessa

signatureAbility.name: Duricrust Rolling Guard
signatureAbility.description: It draws its limbs beneath the banded plates and closes into a ball, and what strikes the shell is turned aside.

lore.description: A lean feline that walks upright on its hind legs, with a long tail and a body that trails vapor at every joint, the Smokat was printed by the secret Generator installed in the bowels of Phantiri to work the dig sites the Imperial Houses opened across the world. It is clever, and in normal form it is flesh and claw, but it can instantly atomize into a cloud of smoke and gather itself again. The Smokat now hunts the haze above the Dreadscape, and uses the same trick for quick evasion and sneak attacks.
lore.biomeNiche: the thick haze over the corpse islands of the Dreadscape

signatureAbility.name: The Scattering Pounce
signatureAbility.description: It comes apart into smoke mid-stride, crosses the ground as haze, and is whole again with its claws already closing.

lore.description: Resembling horned and vaguely humanoid bats with elongated tails tipped with a levitating ball of stone, Terragoyles can be found lining the edges of the Chasm. They were originally used to airlift debris out of Stonera's strip mines with their levitational tails, but now stand guard over the perimeter in a statue-like state, hibernating to conserve their energy until a threat is detected. When awoken, Terragoyles rise high into the sky, using their tails to levitate boulders and fling them like great flying catapults across the Chasm beneath them or to carpet bomb intruders with strafing runs of gravel and rock as they soar overhead.
lore.biomeNiche: the rim of the Chasm strip-mine, perched over a hollow of liquid metal

signatureAbility.name: Perimeter of Standing Stones
signatureAbility.description: It wakes from its statue-like state, rises above the Chasm, and drops the boulders its tail holds aloft onto what crossed the rim.

lore.description: A small winged thing with a long whipping tail, the Tetrahive fights by conjuring a swarm of little flying familiars with teeth like piranhas, holding every one of them in its mind and moving them as a single unit to attack or defend. It was generated on Grimedes not to serve as a labor force but as a test subject, one product of the experiments the Vallerii ran on the Xalian population in laboratories that rumor holds were black sites for ECHELON. It hunts the thick, stalky undergrowth of a world cloaked in perpetual night, and the newest generation of its kind now stands at the edge of the galaxy and watches the endless black.
lore.biomeNiche: the thick stalky undergrowth of the flat, lightless plains of Grimedes

signatureAbility.name: Unbidden Legion
signatureAbility.description: It calls up a wheeling cloud of small toothed familiars and sets them on a single target as one mind, and a familiar that is broken thins away.

lore.description: A large, cobra-like serpent with a broad flaring hood and a rattling tail, the Thirstaserp hides beneath the sand of Endessa, a world whose oceans were vaporized and whose surface is now desert. It emits a subsonic vibration from the rattles on its tail that can lure and mesmerize opponents long enough for it to draw near and attack with a unique venom that drains the victim's water when bitten, causing the victim to suffer and die from extreme dehydration.
lore.biomeNiche: buried in the rolling dunes of Endessa

signatureAbility.name: Thirst of the Endless Sea
signatureAbility.description: It buries its fangs and drains the water out of what it has bitten.

lore.description: A small shaggy climber that hangs from the branches by long-fingered hands, with outsized ears, spiral-patterned eyes that fill half its face, and a long tail tipped in a flat whorled disc, the Tizzie was generated on Telypso to counterbalance the psychic energies of the deranged Vallerii the Imperial Houses marooned there. It works the way its Generator intended: the tail disc turns and draws attention to the eyes, eye contact opens the way, and the treatment proceeds from inside the patient's mind rather than through the body. Since the Nemesis Plague reached the sanctuaries and turned the creatures of Telypso against one another, Tizzies work the same hold on each other in the fungal forests.
lore.biomeNiche: the bioluminescent fungal forests and dense flora of Telypso

signatureAbility.name: Spiral of Perfect Attention
signatureAbility.description: It turns the disc of its tail until the eyes are the only thing worth looking at, and whatever meets them stops where it stands.

lore.description: A shaggy four-legged hunter with a spray tube seated in its gaping jaws, the Venemist carries only two teeth and cannot bite down on anything it wants to eat. The toxic mist it expels from that tube helps to dissolve its prey, and the Generator that shaped it on Drainov was built to fill a world of acid swamps and industrial waste with life capable of surviving there at all.
lore.biomeNiche: acid swamps and the derelict chemical plants of Drainov's factoryscape

signatureAbility.name: Dissolution Veil
signatureAbility.description: The Venemist opens its jaws and drives a fanning mist through the tube seated in them, and what the mist settles on begins to come apart.

lore.description: A long-limbed, shaggy creature whose bones and claws are made from a tough, conductive metal alloy, the Voltish was generated on Zolton, where black lightning did no harm to inorganic matter and the Generator could simply replenish any loss of labor. Zolton's canyons carry visible rivers of electricity that surge like wire currents over the crust. The Voltish stores electrical energy from its surroundings and releases the shock into enemies.
lore.biomeNiche: the deep canyons and metallic peaks of Zolton, where ground-borne lightning surges over the crust

signatureAbility.name: Stormbank Discharge
signatureAbility.description: The Voltish drives the charge it has stored from its surroundings through its alloy claws into whatever they touch.

lore.description: A giant organism of thick, intertwined roots that act as tentacles, the Xylum keeps the greater part of itself buried and shows only the crown of its mass above the soil of the underforests. It lives mostly underground, as this is where it absorbs its power, and its limbs carry rows of short serrations along the last of their length. Some say the oldest Xalians of Floria were born from the first seeds of the Genesis Prototype. Vallerii activity on the planet never grew past small settlements, research labs, and exploration parties, and the Xylum remains in the ground beneath the World Trees.
lore.biomeNiche: the buried soil layer of the underforests, beneath the canopies of the World Trees

signatureAbility.name: Deeproot Reclamation
signatureAbility.description: Xylum sinks its buried limbs deeper and draws the ground's stored power up through them, taking with it whatever stands rooted or pinned in the soil above.

lore.description: Hulking, white-furred apes with the heads of mammoths and tusks made of pure ice, the Yetimoths formed the rank and file of Krystos' prisonguards in ancient times.  If their enormous size and strength was not enough to keep prisoners in line, they could also form thick sheets of ice from thin air, covering themselves in a near-impenetrable armor, blocking off escape routes in walls of frost, or encapsulating their opponents until they could lumber over close enough to pummel them into submission with their meaty, ice-gauntleted fists.
lore.biomeNiche: the high-security prison complexes of the frozen tundra

signatureAbility.name: Mantle of Unyielding Winter
signatureAbility.description: The Yetimoth draws thick sheets of frost out of nothing and layers them over its own pelt until the blows of its opponents stop reaching it.
